findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - the nightly starter workflow omits existing live checks.
The live-test inventory is incomplete. This command excludes Python cases in test_agent_ready.py, test_request_log.py, test_module_schemas.py, test_defaults_soft_delete.py and the projects-python case in test_feature_access.py; none of the Python jobs selects those cases. test_noscreens_starters.py is absent entirely, although its lines 141–149 contain LIVE-gated API and browser report checks for both starters. The other omitted live branches are visible at test_agent_ready.py:49,87,169, test_request_log.py:59,81,111, test_module_schemas.py:68, test_defaults_soft_delete.py:59 and test_feature_access.py:174. Consequently, these owning checks remain deselected or run without their live assertions despite the requirement that the live starter tests run nightly. Include the missing cases in the nightly selections and extend the configuration proof to detect these omissions.
